name: 文件查看器
description: 文件查看器 — 在右栏查看 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf、markdown、html、纯文本（txt/json/log），以及图片、视频、音频；agent 可以直接新建和编辑 docx/pptx/xlsx、新建 PDF/CSV、做 PDF 合并/拆分/裁剪、把 PDF 转成 Office 或 PNG，无需 Python 或外部 Office 软件。文档由内置的 GenOffice 引擎渲染（Apache-2.0）

tools.name: office_guide
tools.description: The op vocabulary for this engine (pptx / docx / xlsx / pdf). Call before writing office_edit or pdf_edit ops; pass group for one pptx group's field tables, examples and common mistakes.

domain.description: Which document family. pptx, docx, xlsx and pdf are wired. pdf returns the pdf_edit page-surgery vocabulary.

group.description: Return one op group's full guide instead of the vocabulary. An unknown group lists the valid ones.

style.description: vocabulary (default) = grouped names, cheapest. signatures = one signature line per op.

tools.name: office_read
tools.description: Read a document's structure — pptx slides and elements, xlsx sheets and cells, docx blocks. The ids it returns are what office_edit targets: read first, then edit.

path.description: Absolute path to the document. For docx it must be a document open in this conversation's viewer (any of its tabs — the viewer switches to it).

tools.name: office_edit
tools.description: Apply a batch of ops to a document and save it. The batch is atomic: use dryRun to validate without writing. Op shapes come from office_guide.

path.description: Absolute path to the document. For docx it must be a document open in this conversation's viewer (any of its tabs — the viewer switches to it).

ops.description: The ops to apply, in order. Get the shape of each op from office_guide.

dryRun.description: Validate and report the plan without writing anything.

tools.name: office_create
tools.description: Create a NEW .pptx / .docx / .xlsx / .pdf / .csv file, optionally with its first content in the same call. Use this whenever the user asks to create, generate or make a presentation, Word document, spreadsheet, PDF or CSV — never Python (python-pptx / python-docx / openpyxl / reportlab / pypdf), cupsfilter, LibreOffice or hand-written OOXML: the app ships its own engines, and the user's machine may have no Python. pptx and docx take the office_edit op vocabulary (call office_guide first); xlsx takes cell ops or a CSV grid; .pdf takes pages/pageSize and text (written on the first page); .csv takes the csv text. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless overwrite is true.

path.description: Absolute path of the new file. The extension picks the format: .pptx, .docx, .xlsx, .pdf or .csv.

ops.description: Optional initial content, applied atomically. pptx/docx: the office_edit op shapes from office_guide. xlsx: { sheet, cell, value } cell ops. Not used by .pdf/.csv. A rejected pptx/xlsx batch writes no file at all.

csv.description: xlsx: the first sheet's grid as comma-separated rows, one row per line (quoted fields supported, numeric cells become numbers) — cheaper than one cell op per value for a table. .csv: the file's text (a UTF-8 BOM is added for Excel). Applied before ops.

text.description: pdf only: text to place on the first page ('\n' stacks lines). GenOffice picks a system font covering the text (CJK included) and writes real searchable text; 1-inch top-left margin, 18pt by default. Use pdf_edit's insertText for other pages/positions.

fontSize.description: pdf text only: font size in points. Defaults to 18.

font.description: pdf text only: preferred system font family. Omit to let GenOffice pick one that covers the text.

sheetName.description: xlsx only: name of the first sheet. Defaults to Sheet1. Use the same name in xlsx ops.

pages.description: pdf only: number of blank pages. Defaults to 1 (max 200). Use pdf_edit for anything beyond blank pages.

pageSize.description: pdf only: paper size. Defaults to A4.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file. Defaults to false, which refuses and tells you to use office_edit.

tools.name: pdf_edit
tools.description: Page surgery and text insertion on a PDF, on GenOffice's own pdf-lib + text-edit layers: merge PDFs, insert/delete/extract/replace pages, insert a blank page, resize, crop, N-up or grid-split pages, split into several files, or place new searchable text on a page (system font, CJK supported). Runs in the backend and writes a NEW file (outputPath); the source is never touched unless outputPath === path and overwrite is true. Call office_guide({ domain: "pdf" }) for the op shapes.

path.description: Absolute path of the source PDF.

outputPath.description: Absolute path of the PDF to write, or (for op "split") the directory that receives the parts. Required: these ops never modify the source implicitly.

ops.description: Ordered page ops. Shapes: office_guide({ domain: "pdf" }).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output (or the source, for an in-place edit). Defaults to false.

tools.name: pdf_convert
tools.description: Convert a PDF into an editable .docx / .pptx / .xlsx, on GenOffice's pure-local pdf2docx rebuild. Text stays editable; pages with no text layer (scans) come through as full-page images and the result says so. Use it when the user wants to turn a PDF into Word/PowerPoint/Excel — do not reach for Python or external converters.

path.description: Absolute path of the source PDF.

outputPath.description: Absolute path of the new document. Defaults to the source path with the extension replaced. Must end with the target extension.

password.description: Password for an encrypted source PDF, when it has one.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output file. Defaults to false.

tools.name: pdf_render
tools.description: Render PDF pages to PNG images, on GenOffice's own pdfium renderer and PNG encoder. No Electron: it runs in the backend. `pages` are 0-based source indexes; omitted renders every page. Files are written as <outputDir>/<name>-p<n>.png.

path.description: Absolute path of the source PDF.

pages.description: 0-based page indexes to render. Omitted = every page.

scale.description: Pixels per PDF point, 0.5..4. Defaults to 2 (about 144 dpi).

outputDir.description: Absolute directory for the PNGs. Defaults to a sibling <name>-pages/ directory.

password.description: Password for an encrypted source PDF, when it has one.

overwrite.description: Replace files already in the output directory. Defaults to false (the whole set is refused before anything is written).

tools.name: files_search
tools.description: Find documents in a workspace by what they are about — Office files (docx/pptx/xlsx), legacy Word/PowerPoint (doc/ppt) and PDFs. Use it when the user refers to a document without giving its path ("the Q3 report", "the proposal that mentions the budget"): it matches file names, folders, extracted titles and a short digest of each document's opening text. Returns absolute paths plus the matched snippet. The index re-checks every file before answering, so edits made outside the app are seen. Plain-text files (md/txt/csv and code) are not indexed — search those with grep.

root.description: Absolute path of the workspace directory to search. Usually the session's working directory.

query.description: A few keywords to match against file names, folder names, document titles and the opening body text — pass keywords, not the user's whole sentence ("华东 预算", not "帮我找那份提过华东预算的文件"). Every word must appear; case-insensitive. Empty returns the most recently modified documents.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: files_open
tools.description: Open a file in this conversation's viewer panel. Required before office_read/office_edit on a docx — that live editor drives the document that is already open. Otherwise call it ONLY when the user explicitly asks to open, show or display a file: never just because a file was attached, sent, mentioned, read or created — opening takes over the right column, so that call belongs to the user.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to show in the viewer.
